text.zh: 多来源均指向奉贤高桥；出生年有1900、1901、1902。
text.en: Sources place his birthplace at Gaoqiao, Fengxian, but give 1900, 1901 or 1902 as his birth year.

text.zh: 上海捐献者个人纪念档记侯涵辉生于1907年5月3日。
text.en: The donor memorial lists 3 May 1907 as Hou Hanhui’s date of birth.

text.zh: 地方资料记东吴二中后进入东吴大学；入学与毕业情况待校史档案。
text.en: Local accounts describe study at a Soochow secondary school and then Soochow University. Enrollment and graduation records remain to be located.

text.zh: 滕圭在《妇女杂志》发表白话诗《一封书》。
text.en: Teng Gui published the vernacular poem A Letter in Funü zazhi.

title.zh: 首次在《申报》刊指画润例

text.zh: 据包、王转录，滕白也在《申报》刊登指画润例，通信处在上海西门普安坊五号。三尺堂幅八元，扇面每柄四元。吴昌硕、王一亭、刘海粟、吴湖帆、黄炎培等联名为其订价。
text.en: Before leaving China, Teng advertised commissions for finger painting. The rates transcribed from Shenbao included eight yuan for a three-chi hanging picture and four yuan for a fan. His mailing address was 5 Pu’an Lane, Shanghai. Wu Changshuo and others endorsed the rates.

text.zh: 12月23日，滕圭乘 President Jackson 抵达西雅图。入境簿同一行记 Dun Kwei 与 Benjamin Duncan，上海签发的学生证明日期为11月12日。
text.en: On 23 December the Seattle register admitted Dun Kwei (Benjamin Duncan), a passenger on the President Jackson, on a student certificate issued in Shanghai on 12 November.

title.en: Study at the University of Washington

text.zh: 华盛顿大学1924–25学年名册将 Benjamin Duncan 和 Dun, Kwei 并列；此后以多个姓名拼写连续登记。他在1927年获美术学士，继而注册为研究生。
text.en: UW catalogues connect the names Benjamin Duncan and Dun, Kwei, record a BFA awarded in 1927, and list subsequent graduate enrollment.

status.zh: 校方连续学籍及授位表
status.en: University student registers and degree list

title.zh: 中国学生会驻国际青年会代表

text.zh: 华盛顿大学年鉴记滕圭为中国学生会驻国际青年会代表。
text.en: The university yearbook lists Dun as the Chinese Students’ Club representative to the International YMCA.

text.zh: 保留题赠托贝的肖像照片，UW23723z。
text.en: A portrait photograph of Teng bears a dedication to Mark Tobey. It is identified as UW Libraries Special Collections, UW 23723z.

text.zh: 华盛顿大学授滕圭美术学士。翌学年校方将他列作研究生。
text.en: The university awarded Dun a BFA in 1927 and listed him as a graduate student in 1927–28.

title.zh: 西雅图报纸记录指画课程
title.en: A Seattle report on fingertip painting

text.zh: 州馆的第3页OCR保留题名，并在副题中把 Kwei Dun、推广课程及指尖作画联系起来。正文OCR质量较差；“闭眼辨色”是报纸标题的说法。
text.en: The state library’s page 3 transcript places Kwei Dun, an extension course and fingertip painting together in the subheading. The claim about distinguishing colors with closed eyes belongs to the headline. The OCR of the body is poor.

title.en: A Chinese poem in English translation

text.zh: 西雅图《The Town Crier》刊出滕圭从中文译成英文的诗。
text.en: The Town Crier published a poem translated from Chinese by Kwei Dun.

title.zh: 两首英译诗发表于《The Town Crier》
title.en: Two translations in The Town Crier

text.zh: 滕圭的两首英译诗 Poem 与 Proximity 在西雅图同页刊出。
text.en: Two translations by Kwei Dun, Poem and Proximity, appeared together in Seattle.

title.en: Landscape in the Northwest artists’ exhibition

text.zh: 滕圭的《Landscape》以第8号入选西雅图第十三届西北艺术家展览。托贝为三位评委之一。
text.en: Dun exhibited Landscape as painting no. 8 at Seattle’s thirteenth Northwest Annual. Tobey served on the jury.

text.zh: Seattle Daily Times刊指画展评与作画照片。
text.en: The Seattle Daily Times published an exhibition review and a photograph of Teng painting.

status.en: Historical clipping; newspaper original to verify

text.zh: 报刊与博物馆履历提到UW矿学院浮雕。 1929年布鲁克林博物馆小传记述楼中浮雕。
text.en: A contemporary clipping and a 1929 Brooklyn Museum biography document Teng’s relief at UW’s College of Mines. The object’s present location remains unconfirmed.

status.zh: 同期报道与馆方新闻稿

title.zh: 指画与毛笔画在东⻄画廊展出
title.en: Finger and brush paintings at the East West Gallery

text.zh: 两份报刊记载展览，6月24日展讯列6月30日为结束日。
text.en: Two period notices record the exhibition. The 24 June listing gives a closing date of 30 June.

title.en: Twenty-two paintings at the Art Association

text.zh: 《Rockford Republic》记 Park Avenue 展厅展品数量及预计展期。
text.en: The Rockford Republic reports the number of paintings and the anticipated run at the Park Avenue gallery.

title.zh: 指画从洛克福德运抵公共图书馆
title.en: The paintings travel from Rockford to the public library

text.zh: 11月2日报道作品已抵，15日报道展览已开放、预定20日结束。两份报道使巡展路线可以相互核对。
text.en: Reports on 2 and 15 November document arrival from Rockford, the open exhibition and a scheduled closing on 20 November.

title.zh: 圣诞号刊五幅指画和访谈
title.en: Five finger paintings and an interview in the Christmas issue

text.zh: 第40页列五幅作品，第41页有肖像、浮雕和访谈。
text.en: Page 40 reproduces five titled paintings; the next page includes a portrait, a relief and an interview.

text.zh: 布鲁克林展讯及模型制作记载；纽约画廊活动见报。
text.en: Brooklyn exhibition notices and accounts of model-making document his museum connections; gallery activity also appeared in the press.

title.zh: Lebold 发表题赠滕圭的诗
title.en: Meddie Maze Lebold dedicates a poem to Teng

text.zh: Meddie Maze Lebold 在西雅图发表题赠滕圭的诗 Beauty Incarnate。
text.en: Meddie Maze Lebold published Beauty Incarnate, dedicated to Kwei Dun, in Seattle.

text.zh: HYI执行委员会批准申请，仍附行政委员会同意条件。
text.en: The Institute’s Executive Committee approved his application, subject to the Administrative Committee’s agreement.

title.zh: 哈佛燕京学社确认批准研究员资助

text.zh: 哈佛燕京学社复函确认北平行政委员会批准给予滕圭哈佛住校研究员资助；此前6月决定的条件已满足。
text.en: The Institute’s Cambridge office acknowledged Peking’s approval of the resident fellowship for Kwei Dun, fulfilling the condition of the earlier vote.

text.zh: 纽约 Weyhe 画廊展出其绘画与石版画。《西雅图每日时报》摘引展册自述，纽约报刊另刊独立评论。
text.en: Weyhe Gallery exhibited Teng’s paintings and lithographs. Seattle coverage quoted his catalogue statement, while the New York Evening Post published a review.

title.zh: 当选英国皇家艺术学会 Fellow
title.en: Elected a Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts

text.zh: 英国皇家艺术学会理事会选举滕圭为 Fellow。11月22日刊出的名单列其住地为美国马萨诸塞州剑桥。
text.en: The Royal Society of Arts elected Teng a Fellow. The list published on 22 November gives his location as Cambridge, Massachusetts.

title.zh: 第五十六街画廊的水墨画
title.en: Ink paintings at the Fifty-sixth Street Galleries

text.zh: 纽约东五十六街6号展出滕圭的水墨画。展评列举山水、鸭、竹和瀑布，特别谈到一幅画竹小品。画廊广告将他的绘画与同时展出的雕塑分别列名。
text.en: Teng’s paintings were shown at 6 East 56th Street. A reviewer identified landscapes, ducks, bamboo and waterfalls, singling out a small study of bamboo. The gallery advertisement distinguishes his paintings from the sculpture on view.

text.zh: 4月30日《哈佛深红报》报道，波士顿二十世纪俱乐部正在展出滕圭的40幅画作，预定展至5月16日。
text.en: On 30 April the Harvard Crimson reported an ongoing show of 40 works in Boston, scheduled through 16 May.

text.zh: 展览公告保留其研究兴趣、资格与展览履历。
text.en: A surviving announcement records his artistic interests, qualifications and exhibition history.

text.zh: 1930–31年展览线索与Clarke注26所引1931–32年第三届展览分开记录。Rocky Landscape 对应场次待核原目录。
text.en: The 1930–31 exhibition lead and Clarke’s reference to the third exhibition in 1931–32 are kept separate pending original catalogue verification.

status.zh: 不同届展览待核原目录

text.zh: 宾大馆藏提要记载1931–32年间滕圭游历英、法、西、德、意，途经印度返华。1932年4月29日哈佛财务处来函明确他当时已到北平燕京大学。
text.en: Penn’s finding aid traces travel through Europe and a return via India in 1931–32. A dated Harvard bursar’s letter places him at Yenching University in Peiping by 29 April 1932.

status.zh: 行程据馆藏提要，返校据原函
status.en: Archival itinerary description and dated bursar’s letter

title.zh: 芝加哥第三届国际石版画与木刻展

text.zh: 芝加哥艺术博物馆第三届国际石版画与木刻展的录选名单在中国项下只列 Teng Kwei。文章说明展至1月24日，未列他的作品题名。
text.en: The list of artists accepted for the Art Institute of Chicago’s third international lithograph and wood-engraving exhibition names Teng Kwei alone under China. The article gives a closing date of 24 January without naming his print.

text.zh: 费城版画会第四届国际蚀刻、干刻与木版画展的名单在中国项下列 Teng Kwei。展至1932年1月2日，报道预告随后到布鲁克林博物馆和伍斯特博物馆展出，未注明滕圭作品的题名和技法。
text.en: The Philadelphia Print Club’s fourth international exhibition of etchings, drypoints and wood blocks lists Teng Kwei under China. The report gives 2 January as the closing date and announces a subsequent tour to Brooklyn and Worcester. His title and medium are unspecified.

text.zh: 预告滕圭在 Evangeline Walker 位于 Holyoke Street 2号的画室主讲 The Background of Chinese Art。它是六场沙龙中的首场，茶会为旱灾募款。
text.en: An advance notice names Teng as the first speaker in a series of six studio salons at Evangeline Walker’s studio, 2 Holyoke Street. His subject was The Background of Chinese Art. The associated tea supported drought relief.

title.zh: 哈佛财务来函记研究津贴已付
title.en: Harvard records payment of a fellowship instalment

text.zh: 哈佛大学财务长萨格致燕京大学司库加赛德的信称，Bodde 与「Mr. Kwei」均已领取第二季度研究员津贴，因此此次汇款未包括二人。此处姓名只作 Kwei，可与同档案1929年任命函及1932年4月关于滕圭的结算函对读；本函未给出他个人所得金额或所在地。
text.en: Harvard’s bursar told Yenching’s treasurer that Bodde and “Mr. Kwei” had already received their second-quarter fellowship stipends. Read with the 1929 award and April 1932 balance letter, this supplies a payment checkpoint. His individual amount and location are not given.

title.zh: 《春花》见多伦多美术馆展品目录

text.zh: 多伦多美术馆展出《Spring Blossoms》，由纽约E. Weyhe借展。
text.en: The Art Gallery of Toronto listed Spring Blossoms in its Flowers and Still-Life exhibition, lent by E. Weyhe.

title.zh: 燕京课程册列为美术讲师
title.en: Lecturer in Fine Arts in the Yenching catalogue

text.zh: 燕京大学文学院公布1932–33学年课程册，列滕圭为国文学系美术讲师，载明其美术鉴赏、技法、雕塑、室内装饰与比较艺术五门课。
text.en: The 1932–33 catalogue listed Teng as Lecturer in Fine Arts and assigned five courses to him, including sculpture and interior decoration.

title.zh: 燕京大学预告中国艺术表现主义讲演
title.en: Lecture on expressionism announced at Yenching

text.zh: 燕京大学预告滕圭在 McBrier Hall 103 室以英语讲《中国艺术中的表现主义》，并放映幻灯。
text.en: Yenching scheduled Teng’s illustrated English-language lecture on Expressionism in Chinese Art in McBrier Hall.

title.zh: 哈佛财务来函确认滕圭已在燕京
title.en: Harvard correspondence places Teng at Yenching

text.zh: 哈佛财务处函称滕圭已在北平燕京大学，寄450美元研究员津贴余款托校方转交。
text.en: The Harvard bursar identified Teng as already at Yenching University and forwarded the $450 balance of his fellowship stipend.

title.zh: 德扬纪念博物馆展出石版画
title.en: Lithographs at the de Young Memorial Museum

text.zh: 加利福尼亚当地艺刊列出滕圭石版画在旧金山金门公园德扬纪念博物馆的展期，1932年5月4日至6月5日。
text.en: The local magazine dates the exhibition of T’eng Kwei’s lithographs at the M. H. de Young Memorial Museum, Golden Gate Park, to 4 May–5 June 1932.

title.en: Two ci poems in Yenching Monthly

text.zh: 《燕京月刊》刊登《浪淘沙·春晨閒步達園》，其后《一剪梅·無題》的作者栏写作「前人」。
text.en: The Yenching monthly printed a lyric about Da Garden under Teng’s name and credited the next lyric to the same author.

text.zh: 吴霖据《顾颉刚日记》记述，1932年10月2日洪业在北平设家宴，滕白也与顾颉刚、马鉴、张铨、盛成等同席。这段材料记录燕京时期的私人往来。
text.en: Drawing on Gu Jiegang’s diary, Wu reports that Teng Baiye attended a dinner at Hong Ye’s home in Beiping on 2 October 1932 with Gu Jiegang, Ma Jian, Zhang Quan and Sheng Cheng. Wu does not identify Teng in the wedding photograph featured in the article.

status.zh: 据顾颉刚日记的后出考读
status.en: Based on a later reading of Gu Jiegang’s diary

title.zh: 倡议成立校园艺术社与常设画廊
title.en: Teng proposes a campus art society and gallery

text.zh: 燕京大学预告滕圭与 Clara C. Park 在新校画廊举行联展；同期校刊刊出滕圭关于设立校园艺术社及常设画廊的倡议。
text.en: Yenching announced a joint exhibition by Teng and Clara C. Park at the new university gallery. In the same issue Teng proposed a campus art club and permanent gallery.

text.zh: Art In Modern China署燕京大学，讨论中国绘画的不同倾向。
text.en: His English essay, signed with a Yenching University affiliation, examines different directions in Chinese painting.

place.zh: 上海出版／燕京大学署衔

title.zh: 为《东方杂志》回答新年征询
title.en: Teng answers the Eastern Miscellany’s New Year survey

text.zh: 在“未来中国”及“个人生活”两个问题下分别发表署名答复，署燕京大学教授。
text.en: Teng answers separate questions on China’s future and his own hopes. The printed attributions identify him as a Yenching University professor.

title.zh: 两幅指画列入芝加哥博览会报送清单
title.en: Two finger paintings submitted for consideration

text.zh: 燕京大学呈送教育部的芝加哥博览会清单列滕圭指画两件，未注明题名。
text.en: A Yenching submission list for the Chicago exposition names two finger drawings by Teng, without titles.

title.zh: 校友返校日两项展览的筹备

text.zh: 燕京大学校友返校日方案列滕圭为学生作品展主席、城内艺术家展经理。
text.en: Yenching’s homecoming programme assigned Teng the chair of its student art exhibit and the management of its city artists’ exhibit.

title.zh: 燕京校内和中央公园个展预告
title.en: Solo exhibition announced on campus and in Central Park

text.zh: 滕圭画展预告先于6月11–12日在燕京大学画廊展出，再于14–21日移至北平中央公园。
text.en: A show of Teng’s paintings was announced for the Yenching gallery on 11–12 June and Central Park, Peiping, on 14–21 June.

title.zh: 沪江大学商学院艺术系出版润例
title.en: Shanghai studio catalogue and price list

text.zh: 书中记沪江大学商学院艺术系以画册形式出版《滕白也雕塑绘画润例》。所录价目分铜像、石膏像、石像、油像、素描、笔画和指画，指画每方尺十二元。
text.en: The University of Shanghai’s business college published an illustrated commission schedule. The rates set different prices for bronze, plaster and stone sculpture, painted or drawn portraits, brush painting, and finger painting. The latter was twelve yuan per square chi.

title.zh: 在沪开设雕塑绘画馆见报
title.en: A Shanghai studio in the press

text.zh: 报道记其已在上海开设雕塑绘画馆，并说朱葆三、张逸云肖像已由亲友订制，又提及吴经熊、茅式训石膏像计划。它能证明报道时已开馆，未交代确切开张日、完成或交付日期；标题也不足以确定回国日。
text.en: This report places Teng’s sculpture and painting studio in Shanghai by November 1933. It records orders from friends or relatives for portraits of Zhu Baosan and Zhang Yiyun and projected plaster portraits of Wu Jingxiong and Mao Shixun.

text.zh: 托贝访上海并继续接触中国书画；具体日程待书信。
text.en: Tobey visited Shanghai and continued his engagement with Chinese painting and calligraphy. Exact dates await correspondence.

title.zh: 柏林展出《钟馗》《雁》和《苍鹰》

text.zh: 柏林普鲁士艺术学院与德国东亚艺术协会展出滕白也的《钟馗》《雁》《苍鹰》；同期图录列尺寸与媒材，并刊出《钟馗》图版（174）。
text.en: The Berlin catalogue lists three works by Teng, their dimensions and media, and reproduces Zhong Kui as plate 174.

title.zh: 报刊记录上海艺术俱乐部讲演

text.zh: 上海艺术俱乐部的演讲报道记录滕圭对线条、用笔与留白的解释：画中的笔意可由看画人补足。报道说他已加入中央大学，并在沪江大学讲授艺术。
text.en: Reporting a lecture at the Shanghai Art Club, the newspaper recounts Teng’s comparison of brush lines and his explanation of a viewer’s role in completing an image. It describes him as on the staff of Central University and giving an art course at the University of Shanghai.

title.zh: 女声社委托纪念碑设计
title.en: A monument for the Nüsheng Society

text.zh: 女声社拟制大理石纪念碑，表彰票选出的十位古今女性。报道点名由滕白也雕刻，构图右侧为手持火把的女性，另有「女界模範」题字。仅据委托消息，尚未查到交付记录。
text.en: The Nüsheng Society named Teng to carve a proposed marble monument honouring ten women. Its design included a torchbearer and an inscription. The report describes a commission.

title.zh: 托贝在信中记下滕家的日常
title.en: Tobey describes daily life with the Teng family

text.zh: 寄给 Elmhirst 夫妇的信中，托贝写到自己在滕家做客，三人共用一间卧室兼饭厅，亲戚常来往。他也记下滕母盼儿子成家。这段生活见闻经 Clarke 引述。
text.en: In a letter to the Elmhirsts, Tobey described taking meals and sharing sleeping space in the same room with two others at Teng’s home. Relatives came and went, and Teng’s mother hoped her son would marry. Clarke quotes the visitor’s account.

status.zh: 同期信件，经研究著作摘引

title.en: A Shanghai lecture on bamboo painting

text.zh: 5月5日英文周刊称滕圭在5月3日用幻灯片讲解竹画。5月7日《申报》称他前一日演讲，5月9日英文报道另记他比较唐、元、清各家画竹。各报的日期和题名分别保留。
text.en: The 5 May weekly dates a lantern-slide lecture to 3 May. Shen Bao on 7 May reports a talk the preceding day. A separate English account on 9 May describes his comparison of Tang, Yuan and Qing bamboo painting. The reports give different dates.

status.zh: 同期中英文报道，日期有异

title.zh: 指画参加艺风社首届画展
title.en: Finger painting at the first Yifeng exhibition

text.zh: 艺风社第一届画展于6月3日开幕，6月10日闭幕；记者在讲话题较多的展品中列举滕白也的指画，未写单件作品题名。
text.en: The report dates the first Yifeng exhibition to June 3–10 and singles out Teng’s finger painting without naming a particular work.

title.en: Teaching art in a home-economics programme

text.zh: 中华妇女节制会和沪大商学院合办家政科的招生消息，将滕白也列为「家庭美术」课程的受聘教师。
text.en: A recruitment notice for a domestic-science programme jointly organised by the women’s temperance association and the University of Shanghai business school names Teng as its instructor in art for the home.

title.zh: 参与筹办生产美术研究社

text.zh: 《申报》刊出上海生产美术研究社的筹组消息。滕白也名列发起人，名单中的滕固是另一人。
text.en: Shen Bao lists Teng Baiye among the initiators of the Shanghai society. Teng Gu appears separately.

text.zh: 伯尔尼艺术展览馆的参展者档案将 T’êng Pai-yeh 列入该展。该站展品清单尚待核对。
text.en: Kunsthalle Bern identifies T’êng Pai-yeh as an exhibiting artist. The objects shown in Bern have not been independently identified.

status.zh: 主办方展览与参展人档案

title.en: The Art of China in Wenhua jianshe

text.zh: 《文化建设》创刊号刊出滕白也《中国的美术》，从建筑、雕塑与工艺谈到学校中的美术教育。
text.en: The first issue of Wenhua jianshe published Teng’s The Art of China, covering architecture, sculpture, crafts and art education.

title.zh: 主持美术生产研究社成立大会
title.en: Chairing the art-and-production society’s founding meeting

text.zh: 报道记成立大会11月10日下午六时假座上海银行公会。主席滕白也致开会词，接着由教育局长潘公展和沪江大学校长刘湛恩致词。
text.en: The society was inaugurated at the Shanghai Bankers Association on November 10. Teng presided and opened the meeting; Pan Gongzhan and University of Shanghai president Liu Zhan’en then spoke.

text.zh: 11月25日下午，滕白也与侯涵辉在沪江大学大礼堂结婚。11月17日订婚报道写作候亞輝，婚后报道写作侯亞輝。书中称介绍人为沪江大学校长刘湛恩的妻子刘王立明。
text.en: Teng married Hou Hanhui at the University of Shanghai on 25 November. The two newspaper notices spell her name differently. Bao and Wang identify Liu Wang Liming, wife of university president Liu Zhan’en, as the person who introduced them.

status.zh: 婚期据同期报道；介绍人据专著
status.en: Date from contemporary reports; introduction from the later study

text.zh: 同期展评记其《鹅》；雕刻学会成立史料记其任秘书。
text.en: A contemporary review discusses Teng’s Goose. Later histories identify him as secretary of the newly formed sculpture society.

status.zh: 参展同期证据；学会二手史料

title.en: New People and New Art published

text.zh: 《新人周刊》新年特辑刊登滕白也《新人與新藝術》，讨论学校美术教育、商业设计与公共艺术机构。
text.en: The New Year issue of Xinren zhoukan published Teng’s essay on art education, commercial design and public institutions.

title.en: An inspector of manual and art education

text.zh: 据年表，滕在上海教育行政部门任劳美视察四个月，负责的领域是劳作和美术。
text.en: The chronology places Teng in Shanghai’s education administration as an inspector for manual training and art from February to June.

text.zh: 年表记长子滕大文出生。
text.en: The chronology records the birth of Teng Dawen, his eldest son.

text.zh: 上海商务印书馆出版Ruth Hsü编选、英译的儿童歌谣集，书目列Teng Kuei为插图作者。所提供《牧童之歌》第73页图像另有2020年论文著录，原书该页仍待独立核对。
text.en: Commercial Press, Shanghai, published Ruth Hsü’s compilation and translation, illustrated by Teng Kuei. The supplied page 73 awaits comparison with an independent original scan.

status.zh: 馆藏书目；逐页及版次核验范围见说明

title.en: Essay on finger painting in Yifeng

text.zh: 滕白也在艺风社第二届展览会专刊发表《指画略说》。
text.en: Teng contributed a history of finger painting to Yifeng’s special issue for its second exhibition.

title.zh: 发表《从美术的来源说起》
title.en: Essay on the sources of art published

text.zh: 《新中華》刊登滕白也《從美術的來源說起》。
text.en: Xin Zhonghua published Teng’s essay on the sources of art.

title.zh: 为上海市立博物馆提出建议
title.en: Proposals for the Shanghai municipal museum

text.zh: 报纸逐条刊出滕白也对筹设中的上海市立博物馆的建议，包括征集中国文物、以复制品讲授西洋艺术、向私人借展和按专题组织展览；亦记载他提出迁移敦煌壁画的主张。
text.en: The newspaper set out Teng’s proposals for the projected city museum: collecting Chinese works, teaching Western art through reproductions, borrowing from private collectors and organising thematic exhibitions. It also records his proposal to move Dunhuang murals.

title.zh: 列名中国音乐会顾问委员会
title.en: Named to a Chinese music concert committee

text.zh: 上海报纸预告Shiao Chao Chinese Music Research Institute 十周年音乐会，把 Teng Kuei 列为筹办首演的顾问委员会成员之一。原文未列他为演奏者。
text.en: A notice for the Shiao Chao Chinese Music Research Institute’s anniversary concert lists Teng Kuei on the advisory committee for the event planned at the Lyceum Theatre. The notice assigns him no performance.

title.zh: 致报馆说明国乐公演筹备分工
title.en: A letter about organising the concert

text.zh: 滕白也在10月11日署名致主笔，订正10月9日的演出报道。他说明演出是为乐团十周年筹办，自己担任义务干事、忙于筹划，并否认指挥排练。
text.en: In a letter signed October 11, Teng corrected the newspaper’s October 9 concert report. He described himself as a volunteer organiser of the ensemble’s tenth-anniversary concert and denied directing its rehearsals.

title.zh: 英文报刊刊登工作室作品专版
title.en: A Shanghai newspaper features the studio

text.zh: 原版十图分别题作孔子、墨索里尼胸像、孔祥熙浮雕、孙中山、Shu Long-si、南京孙中山纪念模型、朱葆三、跑狗场奖杯、上海板球俱乐部奖杯，以及 Mrs. Daystar Hon Teng 与其塑像合影。
text.en: A full-page feature captions ten studio images, among them portraits of Confucius, H. H. Kung and Mussolini, a Sun Yat-sen memorial model and trophies for the Canidrome and the Shanghai Cricket Club. It also shows a sitter beside her sculpted likeness.

title.zh: 日内瓦画报刊出滕白也与孙中山胸像
title.en: A Geneva magazine reproduces Teng with the Sun Yat-sen bust

text.zh: 滕白也站在孙中山胸像左后方。法、英、德三种图注都将作品归给 Teng Peh-yeh。法、英文称材质为大理石。构图与中央社所藏国际社照片0002相同，画报保留了这张照片在日内瓦的刊载记录。
text.en: Teng stands behind his portrait bust of Sun Yat-sen. The French, English and German captions name him as Teng Peh-yeh. The French and English call the bust marble. The composition matches agency photograph 0002 in Taiwan’s Central News Agency collection.

text.zh: 中央社5月14日典藏照片图注明记，南京新街口造像模型在5月10日第三次审查中当选。其后大型铜像计划未实现的说明另依研究文献。
text.en: A 14 May news photograph caption records selection at the third review on 10 May. Later accounts describe the unrealized large-scale project.

status.zh: 评选由同期图注支持，后续据研究
status.en: Selection documented in a contemporary caption

title.en: A preface for a photography collection

text.zh: 据包、王，上海唯美社出版《世界人体摄影名作》，滕白也撰序，讨论人体曲线的节奏，以及中国和欧洲观看身体比例的差异。
text.en: Bao and Wang quote Teng’s preface to an album of figure photography issued by Shanghai’s Weimei Society. He discussed the rhythm of bodily curves and compared Chinese and European ways of looking at bodily proportions.

title.zh: 陶德曼藏画展中的滕圭作品
title.en: Teng’s works in the Trautmann collection exhibition

text.zh: 《Sinica》目录以星号标明参展作品。滕圭名下《钟馗》第45项、《月夜竹》第48项带星号；另五项仅能确认列入收藏目录。目录不证明画家本人到访。
text.en: The Sinica catalogue marks exhibited works with a star: Teng’s Zhong Kui (no. 45) and Bamboo in Moonlight (no. 48). Five other entries document the collection only. This does not establish Teng’s personal attendance.

title.zh: 第二次全国美术展览会

text.zh: 南京第二次全国美展的现代书画目录列《指畫花鳥屏四》（457号），雕塑目录另列《唐少川先生像》（1号）、《前進》（26号），各登记一件。
text.en: The contemporary Nanjing checklists list one flower-and-bird screen (modern painting no. 457) and two sculptures: Portrait of Mr Tang Shaochuan (no. 1) and Progress (no. 26).

text.zh: 年表记在江西庐山塑活佛像。
text.en: The chronology assigns Teng a portrait statue of a living Buddha at Lushan, Jiangxi.

text.zh: 1937年条跨页记长女滕大章出生。
text.en: In its 1937 entry, continued on page 67, the chronology records the birth of his eldest daughter, Teng Dazhang.

text.zh: 1938年6月通讯记滕圭在汉口组织难民生产军需品，工人多为妇女和少女。7月10日他从汉口写信给托贝，回忆此前与家人在桂林避难。
text.en: A June 1938 bulletin places Teng’s refugee workshop in Hankou. Most workers were women and teenage girls. On 10 July he wrote to Tobey from Hankou about the family’s earlier refuge in Guilin.

title.zh: 在信中告诉托贝自己已有两个孩子
title.en: Teng writes to Tobey about his two children

text.zh: 1938年家信记已有两个孩子。家人确认两子一女，排行与书中年表相合：长子滕大文（1935）、长女滕大章（1937）、次子滕大威（1939）。出生年份据书。
text.en: Teng’s 1938 letter records two children. The family confirms the order of three children given in the book: Dawen, Dazhang and Dawei. Their birth years of 1935, 1937 and 1939 come from the published chronology.

status.zh: 书信、出版年表、家人确认

text.zh: 年表记次子滕大威出生。
text.en: The chronology records the birth of his younger son, Teng Dawei.

text.zh: 大学官方资料明确启用日期；与其早期设计活动相关。
text.en: University records give this dedication date. It relates to Teng’s earlier design activity; the precise scope of his contribution needs further documentation.

status.zh: 启用日期强；设计细节待核
status.en: Dedication date confirmed; design details open

text.zh: 据年表，他任桂林纱布药棉厂管理员。
text.en: The chronology places him as an administrator of the Guilin gauze and medical-cotton factory from January 1940 to January 1941.

text.zh: 年表分列广西大学的两项工作：1941年2月至1942年2月任英文教授，同年5月至1942年7月在桂林良丰兼任教授及生活指导。
text.en: The chronology lists two overlapping Guangxi University appointments: teaching English from February 1941 to February 1942, and teaching with student-life duties at Liangfeng, Guilin, from May 1941 to July 1942.

title.zh: 《狮子吼月刊》同页刊登三首诗
title.en: Three poems printed together in Guilin

text.zh: 第1卷第2期第24页并列《即景》《永州朝陽洞》《過定桂門渡》，均署滕白也。
text.en: Three poems by Teng Baiye appeared together on p. 24, including verses named for Chaoyang Cave in Yongzhou and the Dingguimen crossing.

title.en: On Buddhist Art published in Guilin

text.zh: 广西省佛教会《狮子吼月刊》佛教与美术特辑刊出滕白也《谈佛教艺术》。
text.en: Teng’s essay On Buddhist Art appeared in the Guangxi Buddhist Association’s Shizi hou yuekan.

text.zh: 《狮子吼月刊》发表滕白也寄巨赞法师的桂林题诗。
text.en: Shizi hou yuekan published Teng’s poem from Guilin addressed to the monk Juzan.

title.zh: 任桂林西南酒精厂厂长

text.zh: 年表称在桂林开办西南酒精厂并任厂长。
text.en: The chronology identifies Teng as founder and director of the Southwest Alcohol Works in Guilin.

title.zh: 陶德曼所藏《钟馗》在苏黎世展出

text.zh: 图录以 T’eng Po-yeh 署名，称此幅《钟馗》为指画，藏主为陶德曼博士（Oskar P. Trautmann）。画中钟馗转身回望，画幅右边有长题款。与1934年柏林图版174相比，面部、足部、墨色和题款位置均不同，是另一幅《钟馗》。
text.en: The catalogue names T’eng Po-yeh as the artist, identifies the work as a finger painting, and names Dr Oskar P. Trautmann as its owner. The backward-looking figure, feet, ink handling and long right-hand inscription distinguish it from the 1934 Berlin catalogue’s plate 174.

text.zh: 年表记1943年9月在贵阳筹备画展，1944年3月8日在市商会展出花鸟指画一百余幅。
text.en: The chronology records preparations in Guiyang in September 1943 and over a hundred finger-painted bird-and-flower pictures shown at the local chamber of commerce on 8 March 1944.

title.en: A painting presented to Zhou Enlai

text.zh: 地方报道与回忆文章记赠画；题名和件数待藏品档案。
text.en: Local accounts and reminiscences describe a gift of painting. The title and number of works require collection records.

title.en: Work at the China Merchants art office

text.zh: 年表记滕任上海国营招商局美术室主任。
text.en: The chronology identifies him as head of the art office of the state-run China Merchants organization in Shanghai from March to September.

title.zh: 《中国美术年鉴》收录滕白也小传
title.en: The Chinese Art Yearbook profiles Teng

text.zh: 年鉴将滕白也列为雕塑家，记其名圭、籍贯江苏奉贤，称他漫游欧洲研究雕塑，也擅长指画；抗战期间往来桂林、重庆，西南山水使其作品面貌一变。「江苏奉贤人」是本书籍贯用语，并未说明出生地点。
text.en: This contemporary artist directory records his given name as Gui and his native place as Fengxian, Jiangsu. It describes European travel to study sculpture, his finger painting, and how wartime journeys between Guilin and Chongqing affected his art. The native-place entry does not specify a birthplace.

title.zh: 石版画列入石印术150周年展目录
title.en: A lithograph in the 150th-anniversary exhibition catalogue

text.zh: 第449号作品记作 Rain on the Yangtse。原图录给出1902年苏州出生的说法。
text.en: Catalogue no. 449 records Rain on the Yangtse. The same entry gives 1902 and Suzhou as biographical data.

title.zh: 在上海卫生学校制作人体模型

text.zh: 据《画坛遗珠》印页58、69，1950年5月滕白也任上海卫生学校模型厂技师，从事人体模型制作。市文史馆名录亦记其医学模型厂工作。1952年在奉贤另办石膏模型厂。
text.en: Bao and Wang date his appointment as a model technician at Shanghai Health School to May 1950. The municipal institute also records medical modelling work. In 1952 he helped establish a plaster-model workshop in Fengxian.

status.zh: 机构履历；年月据出版年表
status.en: Institutional record; date from published chronology

title.zh: 通信提及考虑赴美工作
title.en: Letters discuss the possibility of work in the United States

text.zh: 据宾大馆藏提要，现存这一组通信在1952年的末段提到滕考虑赴美谋职。
text.en: Penn’s catalogue reports that the correspondence ends in 1952 with Teng considering work in the United States.

status.zh: 馆藏提要，信件原件未阅

title.zh: 在奉贤开办石膏模型厂

text.zh: 书中记他在奉贤召集同乡开办石膏模型厂。
text.en: The biography records that he organized a plaster model factory with fellow villagers in Fengxian.

title.zh: 儿童读物《青青和鳳蝶》出版
title.en: Writing and illustrating a children’s science book

text.zh: 上海少年儿童出版社8月出版《青青和鳳蝶》。版权页将著文、绘图署给滕白也，装帧署赵白山。
text.en: The August first edition credits Teng with both text and illustrations; Zhao Baishan designed the book.

text.zh: 上海少年儿童出版社出版滕白也编著《蚂蚁的生活》。馆藏书目记44页，附插图；封面及内页绘者待版权页核实。同年8月《青青和凤蝶》初版，版权页明确滕白也著、绘图。
text.en: The Shanghai children’s publisher issued Teng Baiye’s The Life of Ants in 1956. Catalogue records list 44 illustrated pages; the illustrator remains unverified. Qingqing and the Swallowtail appeared in August of the same year, explicitly crediting Teng with text and illustrations.

status.zh: 馆藏书目；逐页及版次核验范围见说明

title.zh: 为英国版画展撰写评论
title.en: A review of the British print exhibition

text.zh: 据姜浩峰2022年报道，滕白也观展后在《新民晚报》写《介绍几幅英国版画展中的作品》。展览于6月10–24日在中苏友好大厦举行；文章的原报日期和版面仍待核实。
text.en: According to Jiang Haofeng’s 2022 report, Teng wrote a Xinmin Evening News review of the British print exhibition held at the Sino-Soviet Friendship Building on 10–24 June. The review’s original date and page remain unverified.

status.en: Later report; original review not yet inspected

title.en: Participation in the Letian Poetry Society

text.zh: 书中引《乐天诗讯》第8卷第3期的编者栏，列滕白也与沈瘦石、廉建中、张方仁为编辑，丁方镇为社长，贾粟香为主任编辑。
text.en: The authors cite the March 1957 masthead of Letian Shixun (vol. 8, no. 3), listing Teng among four editors, with Ding Fangzhen as president and Jia Suxiang as chief editor.

text.zh: 滕在《五七感怀》中回顾母亲的养育、渡洋求学、雕塑与指画，也感叹理想受阻。附注由他自述1927年任华盛顿大学助教、获哈佛奖学金三年及获资助赴欧。
text.en: In a poem dated May 1957, Teng recalls his mother, his journey overseas and his work in sculpture and finger painting. His appended notes describe a Washington assistantship and Harvard funding for study and European travel.

title.zh: 工作单位人员在《文汇报》公开点名
title.en: A public attack in Shanghai’s Wen Hui Bao

text.zh: 国营上海医学模型厂署名人员在报上公开攻击滕白也，否定他的雕塑家身份。照片保留批判专栏题头和署名。这一版可确证他已在1957年7月遭遇公开点名；文中指控不作为他的履历。
text.en: A denunciation in Wenhui Bao’s anti-rightist column, signed with the name of the state-run Shanghai Medical Model Factory, attacked Teng’s credentials as a sculptor. It documents public targeting by July 1957. The allegations are not used as evidence about his conduct.

title.zh: 给陈仁炳的私人信件受到公开批评
title.en: A letter to Chen Renbing is quoted in the press

text.zh: 文章开篇摘引滕白也写给陈仁炳的一句话，以政治运动中的贬称指斥两人。可以据此确认1957年8月滕已在报上被公开点名。引文只有一句，写信日期、前后文及信件原件均未见。
text.en: Gu Yan’s polemic quotes one sentence from a letter Teng wrote to Chen Renbing, then publicly attacks the correspondents. It documents a press reference in August 1957. Neither the complete letter nor its date is supplied.

text.zh: 上海市文史研究馆名录记滕白也于1958年被划为右派。此前在1957年7月和8月，他已先后受到《文汇报》和《人民日报》的公开批评。
text.en: The municipal institute’s roster records the designation in 1958. Public criticism in Wen Hui Bao and People’s Daily had already appeared in July and August 1957.

status.zh: 馆员名录；报刊另记前一年遭遇
status.en: Institutional roster and earlier press reports

title.en: A MoMA catalogue discusses Teng and Tobey

text.zh: Seitz 在托贝展览图录中讨论滕的用线教学和1934年上海交往。
text.en: Seitz’s Tobey catalogue discusses Teng’s teaching and the 1934 Shanghai visit.

title.zh: 回忆文章中的劳动与婚姻变故
title.en: Labour and divorce in retrospective accounts

text.zh: 郑逸梅记文革期间因绘画和海外交往遭批判、强制劳动及夫妻离婚。万青力转述上海友人时也写到类似经过。两文未给离婚日期，来源是否独立尚未证明；次子把家庭破裂追溯到1950年代末。
text.en: Zheng Yimei describes political attacks, compulsory labour and divorce during the Cultural Revolution. Wan Qingli relays a similar account from a Shanghai friend. Neither dates the divorce, and the independence of the accounts is unproven. Their younger son dates the family rupture to the late 1950s.

status.zh: 时代背景据回忆，法定离婚年月未详
status.en: Retrospective accounts; date of divorce unknown

title.zh: 长子滕大文在新疆去世
title.en: Death of his eldest son, Dawen

text.zh: 长子滕大文在新疆去世。《画坛遗珠》第70页记他在水库工作时溺亡。家人确认卒年采用1968年，并回忆他曾受批斗。具体月日未见记录。
text.en: Eldest son Teng Dawen died in Xinjiang in 1968. The book states that he drowned while working at a reservoir. The family confirms the year and recalls that he had faced political denunciation. The day and month remain undocumented.

status.zh: 卒年据书中年表并经家人确认

title.zh: 荷兰国立博物馆获赠四幅石版画
title.en: Four lithographs given to the Rijksmuseum

text.zh: Carl Zigrosser 向荷兰国立博物馆赠入四幅滕氏石版画，馆藏号RP-P-1973-255至258。
text.en: Carl Zigrosser gave the Rijksmuseum four lithographs attributed to Teng, accessioned as RP-P-1973-255 through 258.

text.zh: 传记记赵朴初专程去奉贤看望滕白也。
text.en: The biography reports that Zhao Puchu travelled to Fengxian to visit Teng in December 1976.

title.en: Finger painting in an old-city home

text.zh: 滕国俊说，他通过《解放日报》给滕白也写信，得到回信后到寓所拜访。老人扶着餐桌，蘸墨画出竹、石和翠鸟。两星期后滕国俊带着习作再访，后来获赠一幅墨竹。
text.en: Teng Guojun recalled sending a letter through Jiefang Daily and receiving an invitation. At home, Baiye steadied himself on a dining table and painted bamboo, rocks and a kingfisher with his fingers. Guojun returned with his own drawings two weeks later and later received a painting of bamboo.

text.zh: 奉贤区资料把落实政策、平反记在1978年12月，学生回忆提及1978年回沪。上海市文史研究馆名录写1979年平反。区级资料也记他任馆员，具体聘书和改正决定日期待查。
text.en: Fengxian dates rehabilitation to December 1978, and the pupil’s account places Teng back in Shanghai in 1978. The municipal institute records rehabilitation in 1979. His appointment letter and the dated rehabilitation decision have not been located.

date.zh: 晚年平反后（具体年月未载）

title.en: A three-month stay with grandson Teng Yifei

text.zh: 《画坛遗珠》第60页记，大孙子滕一飞从新疆来沪陪伴三个月，随祖父拜访艺术界友人。滕白也嘱他记下所见所闻，书中将这些记录列为还原晚年生活的材料。原笔记及起止日期未见。
text.en: Page 60 of Bao and Wang’s biography says that Teng’s eldest grandson, Yifei, came from Xinjiang for three months and accompanied him on visits to artist friends. Teng asked him to record what he saw and heard. The original notes and dates of the stay have not been located.

title.zh: 参加中山公园艺友画展

text.zh: 《文汇报》〈苍劲何来——访指画家滕白也〉记记者登门观看指画桃花。存世局部摄影能核题名、署名和示范过程；完整篇幅及报头尚未取得。
text.en: A Wenhui Bao interview describes a visit during which Teng demonstrated finger-painted peach blossoms. The surviving photograph verifies the title, byline and demonstration, but omits the complete article and dated masthead.

title.en: Zheng Yimei recalls a fall and confinement to bed

text.zh: 郑逸梅〈指画巨擘滕白也〉开篇记，滕白也原可独自外出，夏间跌倒伤及胫骨，此后卧床。文中以去年、八十岁和冬季描述时间；初刊未核，不能由重编本年份推算发生年，也不能改写既有10月22日的记载。
text.en: Zheng recalls that Teng could go out unaided before a summer fall injured his shin and left him bedridden. The essay uses relative dating and describes his death as occurring in winter. Its first publication date is unknown; the reprint year cannot establish the event year or supersede the reported 22 October date.

summary.en: In Guanfu’s interview, Teng Guojun recalls reading about Baiye in Jiefang Daily in autumn 1978 and sending him a letter through the newspaper. The article dates rehabilitation and his return to Shanghai to 1978.

summary.zh: 滕氏通信档案共152件、584叶，包括家人照片、剪报、书稿及1931–32年欧洲行程表。馆方提要涉及其在英国与Leon Underwood、在法国借住Warneke夫妇工作室、经印度返华，以及1932–52年在华通信中的教学、难民救济和赴美谋职意愿。
summary.en: The collection contains 152 items (584 leaves), including letters, family photographs, book texts and a European itinerary. summary.en: In his serialized memoir, finalist Li Jinfa recalled that five sculptors each received a 700-yuan allowance to continue work for several months on the Xinjiekou commission. sources.author: 滕圭（原信署Teng Kwi）；萬青力译介

summary.zh: 滕圭写给托比，回忆他和妻子自1937年夏在桂林避难，至1938年3月1日。他在汉口告诉友人，自己已有两个孩子，妻子和其中一个孩子在身边。信里还提到刚收到康尼诗小姐来信，并问候共同的朋友。
summary.en: Writing to Tobey from Hankou, Teng recalled taking refuge in Guilin with his wife from summer 1937 until 1 March 1938. He wrote that he had two children and that his wife and one child were with him. He also mentions a recent letter from Miss Cornish and asks after mutual friends.

sources.status: 已读核中文译文印页235–236。万青力说明据Wesley Wehr寄来的两页打字签名信影印本译出；本站取得文集原页，未获得英文信影。
sources.notes: 写于汉口。译文及交代信件来源的按语见《萬青力美術文集》印页235–236；237页说明翻译及转载经过。

sources.title: 滕白也冒充雕刻家
sources.author: 上海《文匯報》「群丑图」栏；文末署名单位为国营上海医学模型厂

summary.zh: 国营上海医学模型厂署名人员在报上公开攻击滕白也，否定他的雕塑家身份。照片保留批判专栏题头和署名。这一版可确证他已在1957年7月遭遇公开点名；文中指控不作为他的履历。
summary.en: A denunciation in Wenhui Bao’s anti-rightist column, signed with the name of the state-run Shanghai Medical Model Factory, attacked Teng’s credentials as a sculptor. It documents public targeting by July 1957. The allegations are not used as evidence about his conduct.

A 20 August 1957 People’s Daily article, by contrast, identifies the sender by his full name and cites a different passage.

sources.title: 擔任雕塑總理銅像之滕白也訪問記
sources.author: 才陵／南京《中央日報》本報特寫

summary.zh: 滕白也说自己来自上海浦东奉贤县，幼时在上海求学；在国外研究雕刻绘画约十年，回国后在燕京大学授课，民国二十二年秋回上海开馆。他说曾搜集五十余张照片、制作七具头像供比较；预计先在南京制作石膏肖像，再运上海翻砂。估计工期约一年，打算把合同期限写为两年。报纸配刊滕近影、孙中山头像及模型全景。
summary.en: Teng placed his hometown in Fengxian, Pudong, and described schooling in Shanghai, study abroad, teaching at Yenching, and his return to Shanghai in autumn 1933 to open a studio. For the Sun Yat-sen project he assembled more than fifty photographs and made seven trial heads. He proposed making the plaster in Nanjing and having it cast in Shanghai, allowing one year for work and two in a prospective contract. Three photographs accompany the interview.

Dawei graduated from Wuhan University and died in Shanghai around 2024.

summary.zh: 《女聲》在1934年3月10日的报头将刘王立明列作社长。同月27日，《申报》报道该社请滕白也为票选女界人物制作纪念碑；11月的婚礼报道又将王立明列作到场宾客。两份同期材料为后来家属所说的婚礼介绍人补出她与滕白也此前的工作联系。报头没有列侯亚辉。
summary.en: The 10 March 1934 masthead identifies Liu Wang Liming as head of Nüshengshe. On 27 March Shenbao reported that the society had commissioned Teng to make a monument honoring women. Wang Liming later appears among guests at Teng’s wedding. These sources document an earlier institutional connection with the woman later identified as the couple’s matchmaker. The masthead does not name the bride.

sources.author: 郑逸梅；《前尘旧梦》北方文艺版，QQ阅读

summary.zh: 郑逸梅记滕白也晚年某夏跌伤胫骨、此后卧床，并在文革叙述中提及因绘画和海外交往遭批判、强制劳动及夫妻离婚。文章未给离婚日期，也没有交代妻子此后的职业或住处。
summary.en: Zheng recalls a fall in summer that injured Teng’s shin and left him bedridden. He also describes political attacks over painting and foreign contacts, compulsory labour and divorce. The text supplies no divorce date or details of the wife’s subsequent work or residence.

sources.status: QQ阅读公开正文已阅；初刊及各编本差异待核
sources.notes: 所读为2016年《前尘旧梦》第25章的公开展示正文，不是原刊影印。开篇以去年和八十岁叙事，称夏间跌伤、冬季去世；初刊时间未核，不据此改定死日。文中只称夫人，未写侯氏姓名。劳动与离婚段和万青力S238相近，不能视为两个已证独立来源。2019《林下云烟》起页70、下篇73；《艺坛百影》1982年馆藏NCID BA45963926；各本待校。

sources.type: 研究论文公开摘要与期刊目录
sources.title: Learning from the East: Mark Tobey’s Formative Influences and the Artistic Bond with Teng Baiye
sources.author: Phyllis Hanyang Zhong / Yishu: Journal of Contemporary Chinese Art

summary.zh: 刊方目录列文章起页57，下一篇起页67；公开摘要讨论滕白也对托贝笔法、书法和白色书写的影响。正文未取得，暂不能判断是否含晚年新材料，亦未把它与同作者2024年论文视为同文。
summary.en: The official contents place the article at p. 57, with the next essay beginning at p. 67. Its public abstract concerns Teng’s influence on Tobey’s brushwork and white writing. The full text remains unread and has not been equated with Zhong’s 2024 article.

sources.status: 刊方公开摘要及目录已核；全文待查
sources.notes: 2026年2月28日刊方发布第105期说明。目录起页57；终页未以原刊核验。全文与注释尚待查阅；是否引用新增家藏资料、晚年回忆或采访，不能由摘要确定。

summary.en: The editors identify a substantial Teng biography in issue 4 of Fengxian Wenshi, intended to supplement the earlier county gazetteer. This periodical began in June 2009 and is distinct from the older CPPCC series Fengxian Wenshi Ziliao.

sources.author: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian

summary.zh: 司徒雷登于1946年7月12日获任驻华大使，7月19日递交国书。原稿在1929年荐学情节中使用“美国驻华大使”是把后来的职衔提前。
summary.en: Stuart was appointed ambassador to China on 12 July 1946 and presented credentials on 19 July. Calling him the ambassador in a 1929 recommendation is anachronistic.

sources.status: 官方任职日期已核
sources.notes: 1929年应按当时燕京大学校长身份表述，荐学信见S171。

summary.en: The catalogue identifies a 2024 facsimile containing issues 1–3 of Meishu zazhi, published by Liangyou in January–June 1934, with Studio on the cover. Saitama University holds the volume.

summary.zh: 文章将《沪大周刊》列入沪江大学校园演讲史料，英文校名为University of Shanghai。这能订正2020论文的Shanghai University写法，但不证明尚未取得的滕奎演讲原页。
summary.en: The university journal identifies Huda zhoukan as a source for University of Shanghai campus lectures. This corrects the institutional name in the 2020 essay; it does not verify the still-unlocated Teng lecture item.

sources.status: 正文及学校—刊物关系已核；所指滕奎短讯原页待核

issues.approach: “亞勃林”最可能指Oberlin College。1934年婚讯所称音乐学士究竟为哪种专业学位、正式注册姓名与毕业年份均待核。 家史将Louise How／Loo-yee／璐懿与Oberlin相连，支持排除Loo Y. How近名候选；这不是侯氏本人的学籍证明。
issues.next: 校务秘书处历年中国学生卡、注册处学生档、幼师学校校友卡；俄州同名近名学生不自动合并。 招生处音乐学院申请档案RG 25、系列VI；注册处成绩和幼师成绩单。

issues.title: 三个子女的月日与后期履历
issues.conflict: 长子滕大文卒于1968年。长女滕大章赴新疆的确年和卒日、次子滕大威大学毕业年份及确切卒日未见可核公开原始记录。
issues.approach: 出生年份及长子卒年据《画坛遗珠》；长女和次子的近似卒年按家人原述。
issues.next: 武汉大学档案馆录取与毕业名册、历史学籍；新疆水库单位名册、事故记录或同时代讣告。

issues.title: 侯涵辉何时离婚及离婚后的生活
issues.conflict: 次子把家庭破裂放在1950年代末。万青力引友人说，夫妻在政治压力下离婚，各自谋生。尚无登记日或裁判日期。
issues.approach: 两种表述分别归属原作者；侯氏1982年登记捐献和1995年实现捐献，另有个人纪念档。
issues.next: 以滕圭／滕白也及侯涵辉／侯亚辉双向查登记或判决。核对工作、住址须另见本人档案。

issues.title: 《喜上眉梢》的戊午纪年
issues.conflict: 画面可初读戊午；在通常采用的生年范围内对应1918或1978。
issues.approach: 保留干支纪年，不据论文编排位置定为晚年作。
issues.next: 核更清晰题款、印章及实物来源。

issues.title: 儿童读物的版次与绘者署名
issues.conflict: 2020论文把《青青和凤蝶》写作“与”并记1957；还称《蚂蚁的生活》由滕著绘。
issues.approach: 前书据版权页采用1956年8月、滕白也著绘；后书确认1956年及编著者，绘者待核。
issues.next: 取得《蚂蚁的生活》版权页及原书全册。

issues.title: Mountain Landscape的哈佛藏本归属
issues.conflict: 2020论文称哈佛收藏；图像与荷兰国立博物馆W062构图相同，但未核哈佛馆藏号。
issues.approach: 记录相同构图线索；不同印本不合并为同一馆藏实物。
issues.next: 核哈佛馆藏号、尺寸及来源；比对纸张与题赠。
